newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.26 pct lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.26 pct lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down 0.26 percent in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 480.13 points, down from 481.36 on Monday.
Total volume was 7.73 million dinars against 2.94 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 7.17 million dinars.
UBCI bank fell 1.4 dinar to 45.6 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN slid one dinar to 32.78.
Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.82 to 26.56 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat BHH.TN eased 0.32 dinar to 16.16. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie declined 0.1 dinar to 32.1 dinars.
Household firm Ateliers Mecanique du Sahel edged lower 0.1 dinar to 11 dinars. Airline Tunis Air was down 0.1 dinar to 23.9 with 7,459 shares changing hands.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT won 1.72 dinar to 88.74 dinars. Detergent firm SPCD rose 0.46 dinar to 35.48. Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL was up 0.12 dinar to 16 dinars. ($1=1.1 dinar)
